195: def flagship_only(
196:     request: Request, agent_type: Optional[str], stored: Optional[str] = None
197: ) -> Optional[str]:
198:     """Hold Agent UI requests to the flagship; return the agent type to use.
199: 
200:     Requests from other clients pass through unchanged. From the Agent UI, a
201:     requested non-flagship agent is a 422, and a chat stored under a retired
202:     agent is a 409 that says to start a new chat -- never a silent reroute.
203:     """
204:     if request.headers.get(CLIENT_HEADER_NAME) != AGENT_UI_CLIENT:
205:         return agent_type
206:     if agent_type and agent_type != FLAGSHIP_AGENT_ID:
207:         raise HTTPException(
208:             status_code=422,
209:             detail=(
210:                 f"The Agent UI runs the GAIA agent only; agent_type {agent_type!r} "
211:                 "is not available here. Use `gaia eval agent --agent-type` or the "
212:                 "CLI to run another agent."
213:             ),
214:         )
215:     if stored is not None and stored != FLAGSHIP_AGENT_ID:
216:         raise HTTPException(
217:             status_code=409,
218:             detail=(
219:                 f"This chat was made with the retired {stored!r} agent, so it is "
220:                 "read-only. Start a new chat; GAIA covers what that agent did."
221:             ),
222:         )
223:     return FLAGSHIP_AGENT_ID

88: @router.post("/api/chat/send")
89: async def send_message(
90:     request: ChatRequest,
91:     http_request: Request,
92:     db: ChatDatabase = Depends(get_db),
93: ):
94:     """Send a message and get a response (streaming or non-streaming).
95: 
96:     Concurrency is controlled at two levels:
97:     1. Every turn on a local model waits in one visible line for it
98:        (``turn_queue``); a cloud turn doesn't.
99:        A streamed turn waits inside its detached run and reports its place
100:        in line; a non-streamed one waits here, its message already saved,
101:        until it reaches the model or is stopped with ``/api/chat/cancel``.
102:     2. A per-session lock (session_locks) prevents the same session
103:        from having overlapping requests that would corrupt conversation
104:        state.
105:     """
106:     # Verify session exists
107:     session = db.get_session(request.session_id)
108:     if not session:
109:         raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Session not found")
110:     request.agent_type = flagship_only(
111:         http_request, request.agent_type, session.get("agent_type") or "chat"
112:     )
113: 
114:     # ── Per-session lock ─────────────────────────────────────────────
115:     # setdefault is atomic: safe under concurrent requests for the same session
